answer: In this PoA design, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while temporal decay applies an exponential half-life to reputation. Honest influence therefore requires sustained, mutually validated service; a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, negligible transitive support, and cannot pass consensus merely by multiplying identities. Even coordinated nectar, quartz, or canyon accounts remain isolated until independently trusted over time.
